jobs.title: Validate public product and onboarding surfaces
commands:
from pathlib import Path
pages=['index.html','product/index.html','how-it-works/index.html','use-cases/index.html','security/index.html','get-started/index.html','docs/index.html','status/index.html']
for p in pages:
    assert Path(p).is_file(), p
    t=Path(p).read_text()
    assert 'https://setup.clawkraft.dev/signup' in t, p+' missing Get Started route'
    assert 'https://app.clawkraft.dev/' in t, p+' missing Login route'
print('clawkraft-web surfaces qualification: PASS')

jobs.title: Validate privileged controls stay off clawkraft.com
commands:
from pathlib import Path
forbidden_ids=['hardstop','enableall','disableall','workertoggle','authorityenvelope','pauseprogram','resumeprogram']
for p in Path('.').rglob('*.html'):
    if any(part.startswith('.') for part in p.parts):
        continue
    t=p.read_text().lower()
    for fid in forbidden_ids:
        assert f'id="{fid}' not in t, f'{p} contains privileged control marker {fid}'
idx=Path('index.html').read_text()
assert 'href="https://setup.clawkraft.dev/signup"' in idx
assert 'href="https://app.clawkraft.dev/"' in idx
print('clawkraft-web boundary qualification: PASS')
